{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Exclude rows with sentinel value in biomarker_baseline
valid_data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Confirm the remaining population
print(f"Number of patients with both valid baseline and follow-up: {len(valid_data)}")

# Compute change in biomarker levels
delta = valid_data['biomarker_final'] - valid_data['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute mean change
mean_change = delta.mean()

# Output the result
print(f"Mean change in biomarker levels: {mean_change}")

# Return the value
mean_change"}
